fullContent:
Anand Bhairav Ras 
 Reference – Ayurveda Sara Sangraha, 17 edition, 258 – 259. 
 Introduction 
 Anand Bhairav Ras is a polyherbal ayurvedic formulation that is prepared from the mixture of many herbs. Anand Bhairav Ras is used in the treatment of acute and chronic fevers, especially those associated with respiratory and digestive issues. 
 Ingredients 
 
 Shuddha Parad – purified and processed mercury 
 Shuddha hingula – purified and processed cinnabar 
 Vatsanabha – Purified Aconitum ferox 
 Saunth – Zingiber officinale 
 Maricha – Piper nigrum 
 Pippali – Piper longum 
 Shuddha tankan – purified borax 
 Bijora nimbu ras – Lemon juice extract Quantity Sufficient 
 Bhringraj swaras 
 
 Method of Preparation 
 
 Take all the ingredients up to 10 grams 
 First take all the ingredients and powder the ingredients. 
 Now mix all the ingredients and triturate with bhringraj swarasa. 
 After the triturate process, grind the mixture and triturate with bijorra nimbu ras. 
 Now take the paste up to 125 mg and make pills from it. 
 
 Dose 
 One to two tablets with ginger juice, honey, pomegranate juice or katuja’s bark kwatha. 
 Indications 
 
 Kapha related disorders like cough, respiratory and indigestion etc. 
 Fever 
 Malabsorption 
 Bloating 
 Loose motions 
 Vata related disorders 
 
 Contraindications 
 Take the medicine under doctor’s prescription. 
 
 Note:- This is pure classical Ayurvedic medicine and should be strictly consumed only after prescription of an Ayurvedic doctor and to be taken under medical supervision only.
